note: Leave affiliate_id and affiliate_param empty until a public affiliate or publisher ID is issued. Set both together. affiliate_param is the query-parameter name the network uses (it is not guessed here). scripts/build.py appends that parameter only to the partner's visit link on the mail-in page. Source citations are never rewritten. Leave both fields empty for an ordinary link. Do not put API secrets, passwords, or private tokens in this file.
